items.q: Maggie Hawthorn is identified as the interviewer in the header and asks questions; the interviewee responds to her questions but no personal relationship beyond the interview context is described.

Interviewer:
Maggie Hawthorn
Las Vegas, Nevada
October 30 - November 2, 1980
It says in the Encyclopedia that you are William Howard Montgomery, but I've never known you as anything but Monk. When did you get that name?
